title: OXVA Xlim EZ Replacement Vape Pods – 3-Pack
description: Designed to provide versatility and ease of use, the OXVA Xlim EZ Replacement Pods provided an upgraded, enhanced experience with the OXVA Xlim family of pod kits over the previous generation of Xlim pods. The EZ pods offer a satisfying, leak-resistant vaping experience, with fixed coils that eliminate the need for coil changes. Available in a 3-pack, each pod has a 2ml capacity and a choice of resistances to suit both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) preferences. With a top-fill system for straightforward refills that can be performed without the need to detach the pod from the device the OXVA Xlim EZ pods are crafted to deliver effortless convenience alongside long-lasting flavour and performance. They’re ideal for Nic Salts, 50/50 blends, and high-PG e-liquids, providing a smooth throat hit and rich flavour with every puff. Available in the following resistances: 0.4ohm RDL (Red) – Best suited for 26-30W, providing a warm, dense vapour ideal for restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping. Best with low-nicotine, 50/50 e-liquids; High-VG E-liquids. 0.6ohm RDL (Black) – Performs best between 20-25W, delivering a balance of flavour and vapour for a smooth RDL experience. Best with low-nicotine, 50/50 e-liquids; High-VG E-liquids. 0.8ohm MTL (Orange) – Optimised for 12-16W, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with a smooth, flavourful draw. Best with Nic Salts, 50/50, and High-PG e-liquids. 1.2ohm MTL (Green) – Designed for 10-12W, offering cooler vapour and intense flavour with a tighter MTL draw. Best with Nic Salts, 50/50, and High-PG e-liquids. Note: Due to those devices power configurations, the 0.4ohm Xlim EZ cartridges are not compatible with Oxva Xlim SE, Xlim SQ and Xlim V2 pod systems. Oxva Xlim V2, V3, and EZ pod cartridges are not compatible with the Oxva Xlim C pod vape kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
